input: Two disjoint regions sized 5 and 8 MiB; store 1 leader, store 2 witness follower, store 3 pending learner; stores 0 and 4 have no peers; store 4 Removed. Initial region_count=99.

sources.status: basic_cluster.go UpdateStoreStatus delegates seven values to store.go StoresInfo.UpdateStoreStatus, which shallow-clones present entries and skips absent IDs. Old handles retain 99. UpdateAllStoreStatus skips IsRemoved; direct update does not.

sources.leader: basic_cluster.go GetLeaderStoreByRegionID explicitly returns nil for absent region or absent leader (even with store 0); absent registered leader store returns GetStore nil. These branches are source-derived.
